description: This header file defines inline functions related to fsmonitor functionality in the git version control system. It manages cache entry marking, invalidation, and checks if the fsmonitor has been refreshed, interacting with other fsmonitor, repository, and cache components.

methods.name: int is_fsmonitor_refreshed(const struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Checks whether the fsmonitor has been refreshed at least once, based on the repository settings and internal flags.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as valid from fsmonitor perspective, unless it's a submodule, and updates the index's change flags.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry's fsmonitor validity and triggers untracked cache invalidation for the path.

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_invalid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_valid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/
